subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: Gold is a bright precious metal. There are many metals cheaper (a)_____ gold but look like it. (b)_____ they become faded in course of time. Actually, there are some people in our society (c)_____ are outwardly nice and gentle. But (d)_____ a period of time, their real identity is revealed. (e)_____all that glitters, is not gold.
guide_solution: (a) than (b) But/However (c) who (d) after (e) So /That is why
